name: heelys_henry
tag: i roll. dennis walks. we both know who is winning (i am) (dennis disagrees)
hometown: Huber Heights, Ohio (our street slopes about 4 degrees, i measured with a level from the garage, it's perfect)
zodiac: Aries. starxgazer said it means 'fast, impulsive, can't sit still.' i said yeah. she said 'it also means wear a helmet.' i think she talked to my mom
hereFor: Friends, Friends who skate, Friends who know where the good floors are
blogTitle: roll report (surface ratings out of 10) (updated whenever i fall)
about: ok so. hi. i'm henry, i'm 13, and i have wheels in my shoes. like in the heel. they pop out. my mom thinks they're 'athletic shoes' because that's what i told her in the store and she believed me and it's been 7 months. i roll everywhere. the school hallway until a teacher says 'henry,' the mall (banned from 3 stores), the driveway, the kitchen at 6 am when nobody's up. my record is 1 whole lap of the mall without putting a foot down. 41 minutes. it's a big mall. i also have a rivalry with a security guard named dennis. he knows. we've never really spoken. he says 'son.' that's most of the conversation. i keep a scoreboard.
aboutMore: things you should know. 1) i'm banned from sam goody, spencer gifts and the disney store. each one was an accident and each one was a little bit my fault. 2) holly at hot topic is the only one who let me stay. the deal is wheels in my pocket, i walk, like a saloon. i have never broken the deal. 3) dennis has written me up 6 times. i keep the pink slips in a shoebox. it's my favorite shoebox. 4) i'm not that fast. i'm just not slow.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: whoever invented the heel wheel (thank you, also what are the bearings). tony hawk, to ask if he ever got chased by someone named dennis. dennis (not to talk. just to see his legs run. i've never seen them). a mall with a downhill. the lady at the pretzel place who has a back door deal with me.

interests.General: heelys (black with orange wheels), rolling backwards, tile (9/10), carpet (1/10, a crime), the long hall by sears (10/10), orange julius, power slides, the glass elevator (3 floors, 11 seconds), the fountain (8/10, the coins are marbles), my knee pads (mom's rule), bearings (i can name 3 kinds), my beagle axle, my sister jenna's car (she drops me at the door and pretends she doesn't know me)
interests.Music: simple plan (i'm just a kid. that's the song on my page. it's about me), blink-182, good charlotte, the all-american rejects, the song in the heelys commercial, whatever dennis hums (he hums. i've heard it from the stockroom. i think it's a polka)
interests.Movies: the sandlot (brad said i'd like it. i did), ferris bueller's day off (the principal is dennis too. i've never been so seen), cool runnings, the incredibles (dash, obviously), rookie of the year, spy kids
interests.Television: saturday morning cartoons (i'm too old but i'm not too old), the x games, mythbusters (the friction episode, watched it 4 times), whatever's on in the sears electronics department while i roll past (it's always golf)
interests.Books: the guinness world records (the speed roller skating page), my math textbook (the chapter on rates, distance equals rate times time is basically my life), the mall directory (i have it memorized. it's a hobby. it says YOU ARE HERE and that's my favorite sentence)
interests.Heroes: sk8rboi_mike (the loading dock behind the mall is basically our turf), derek (his gap is bigger, i say it too), holly (rules are a kind of respect), my sister jenna, tim (made DENNIS DODGE, owes me $2, still a hero), the pretzel lady, dennis (shh)

ambient: new record. 1 whole lap of the mall with no foot down. 41 minutes. the mall is a big mall. i had a pretzel at the 22 minute mark, in motion. it was perfect.
ratings update: the new tile outside the shoe store is a 10/10. the carpet by the elevator is a 1. i know it's the same building. it's not. it's two different countries.
my mom found my knee pads in the dishwasher. i said they were dirty. she said they were on the top rack. i said i'm responsible. she hugged me. i don't know what happened.

in math today mr. fenn asked what a rate is. i said 'speed.' he said 'distance over time.' i said 'that's speed.' he said 'yes.' i got an A on the quiz. i think i got an A on a quiz about my own life.

sam goody update: i've been banned 61 days. there's a note at the door. it says 'no wheeled footwear.' that's the whole note. it's not my fault, it's a design problem. the aisles are 5 feet wide and i'm 4 foot 11.
someone asked if heelys are 'a real shoe.' i said they're a shoe with a secret. i've been thinking about that sentence all day. i might put it on a shirt. holly could price it.
saltyDm: oh. denied. ok. that's cool. i'm not mad. i'm just going to roll around the kitchen once in a circle, slowly, and think about it. you can still be my friend in my head. there's a lot of room in there. it's mostly hallway.

keywords.heelys: they're shoes with a wheel in the heel. you lean back and go. my mom thinks they're athletic shoes and it's been 7 months. the wheel pops out so you can walk. i've never walked. i mean i've walked. i just don't remember it.
keywords.dennis: mall security. mustache. radio. says 'son.' that's basically all he's said to me in 7 months (one time he said 'no skating in the lot' and i said it's rolling and he said 'son'). he never runs. i've never seen his legs go fast. he walks like he's wading through a river and somehow he's always there. my record: 33 chases, 4 catches. i'm not saying who's winning. i'm saying 33.
keywords.mall: 3 floors. tile on the main level (9/10), carpet upstairs (2/10), a glass elevator (11 seconds), a fountain with coins (hazard), and the long hall by sears (10/10, it's a crime that it's not an olympic sport).
keywords.shoes: the ones i'm wearing have a wheel. the wheel is the size of a cookie. an actual small cookie. it's carried me through 7 months and 33 chases and 3 bans. it's the bravest thing i know.
keywords.banned: 3 stores: sam goody (i unplugged 3 listening stations by accident, with my backpack), spencer gifts (a lava lamp wobbled, it didn't fall, it WOBBLED), the disney store (a snow globe display, the floor shook). hot topic is NOT on the list. i want that on the record. holly's rule. wheels in the pocket.
keywords.fast: i'm not that fast. i'm just not slow. my top speed is 11 mph on the long hall by sears (my sister timed me from the car. it was her idea. then she said don't tell mom).
keywords.school: 8th grade. i'm banned from wheels in the gym and the cafeteria. i'm allowed in the hall. i'm 'tolerated.' the vice principal said that. it's the nicest thing anyone's said about me at school.
keywords.pretzel: cinnamon sugar. eaten at speed. the lady at the counter says no wheels at the counter and then waves me around to the back door where there's tile and a different kind of deal. you didn't hear that.

sk8rboi: mike i rolled the whole loading dock behind the mall. the smooth part. 4 minutes 11 seconds, no falls. i know it's not a skateboard but i felt it in my chest. like a rail. can i hold the camcorder saturday. i'll hold it so still

bulletins.subject: OFFICIAL SURFACE RATINGS FOR THE MALL (upper and lower)
bulletins.body: long hall by sears: 10/10. food court tile: 9/10 (watch the grease). fountain surround: 8/10 (the coins are marbles). glass elevator: 4/10, it's not a surface, it's a feeling. carpet outside the arcade: 1/10, a crime. the ramp by entrance 4: 9/10 and it's probably illegal. parking lot behind the mall: 7/10 (sk8rboi's turf, ask first). sidewalk outside blockbuster: 8/10 (brad lets me use the ramp). ratings change if they wax. they wax on thursdays. i'm there on thursdays.

bulletins.body: my mom made me post this. she said it's a restorative act. i said it's a bulletin. she said same thing. 1. i will not roll in the disney store. 2. i will not roll in sam goody. 3. i will not roll in spencer gifts. 4. i will not borrow a shopping cart. blog.title: the day dennis wasn't there
blog.body: ok so on tuesday dennis wasn't at the information desk. i figured he was at lunch. wednesday he wasn't there either. thursday i rolled past his desk 3 times and his chair was just a chair. the mall felt like school on a snow day. i won by default, which isn't winning. i asked the information lady where he was. she said 'who.' i said dennis. she said 'why do you care.' i said i don't. she said ok. friday he was back. he was standing by the fountain like nothing happened. i was at the pretzel place with a pretzel. he looked at me. i looked at him. he said 'son.' i said 'dennis.' he said 'what did you call me.' i said 'sir.' he said 'son.' then he started walking toward me and i left and it was the best chase of my life. i'm not saying i missed him. i'm saying it was 3 days and i counted.

blog.title: how to roll in a mall (a guide) (don't)
blog.body: rule 1: knee pads. rule 2: helmet in the car, mom checks. rule 3: say 'excuse me' to every person. it's not rude, it's a flag. it tells them you see them. rule 4: never roll toward a stroller. never. rule 5: know your surfaces. tile is a 9, carpet is a 1, grout lines are a 3 and they will end you. rule 6: if you have to stop fast, don't. turn. turning is just stopping with a better attitude. rule 7: when you see a store with a 'no wheeled footwear' sign, take the wheels out and put them in your pocket and walk in like a normal person. you will be shocked how nice it is to walk. rule 8: if a man says 'son' stop. (i have never stopped. rule 8 is for you.)

blog.title: banned from 3 stores: ranked by how much it was my fault
blog.body: 3rd: the disney store. 10% my fault, 90% snow globes. i rolled in at a normal speed and the display was on a table that was on a slight tilt and i'm not saying the floor shook but the globes did a little wave. 2nd: spencer gifts. 30% my fault. a lava lamp wobbled. it didn't fall. it WOBBLED. the guy said 'that's a hazard.' i said it's a lava lamp. it's supposed to move. 1st: sam goody. 60% my fault. i unplugged 3 listening stations with my backpack as i went by and the cords were not long enough for the speed i was going. i still don't know what i was listening to. the guy at the counter said 'sir.' that was the first time anyone called me sir. i'll be honest, i kind of loved it. i'll be back when i'm 14. i'll be a man by then.
